sentences.text:
Through: Ms. Nandita Rao, ASC f  with ASI Om Prakash, P  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT SHARMA  ORDER % 22.03.2023 1.

The present writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks following prayers:
"a) Issue writ/order/direction thereby quash the FIR bearing No.:85/2023, dated 12.03.2023, u/s 498A/406/34 IPC, P.S: Tigri and consequent proceedings arising out of the said FIR in the interest of Justice.

b) Pass any other or further orders as this Honble Court may deem fit and proper in the given facts and circumstances of the case."
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners, without prejudice to the rights and contentions of the latter,
seeks leave to withdraw the present petition with liberty to place the facts stated herein before the Investigating Officer in the present FIR.
4. The present petition is dismissed as withdrawn and disposed of accordingly.
5. Pending application(s), if any, also stand disposed of.
